description: The participant list (first, last, family group, wishlist) is saved to localStorage key giftExchange.participants on every add/remove/import and restored on load, so testing doesn't require re-typing and later features (Bad Santa) can reuse it. A 'Clear list' button empties it (with confirm). Persistence lives behind an injectable store so it stays testable.

Bad Santa (white elephant) mode, switched from the card's mode toggle. Players come from the saved list and draw numbers (turn order); one wrapped gift per player. A turn = unwrap a new gift (type what it is) or steal any unlocked unwrapped gift. The stolen-from player goes immediately and can't take back a gift taken from them that turn. A gift locks after 3 steals. After everyone goes, #1 gets one optional final steal (a swap, no chain). Game state saved in localStorage giftExchange.badSanta (versioned) so refresh resumes. Engine BadSantaGame (pure, injectable random) + BadSantaStore + BadSantaUI in bad-santa.js.
verification: npx jest tests/unit/bad-santa.test.js tests/architecture && npx playwright test tests/e2e/bad-santa.spec.js
